name: Whitesburg Electronics Inc
old_description: Founded by Wayne Jacks in 1977, Whitesburg Electronics. manufactures high-quality electronics and electro-mechanical assemblies and provides solutions for government, industry, and commercial clients.
about:
Founded in 1977 by Wayne Jacks, Whitesburg Electronics operates from a 32,500-square-foot facility in Laceys Spring, Alabama. The company began as a provider of electronic and electro-mechanical assemblies for government, industrial, and commercial clients.

Today the shop delivers printed circuit board assembly (through-hole and surface-mount with fine-pitch capability down to 5 mm), wiring harness and cable assemblies, chassis wiring, conformal coating, and full electro-mechanical box builds. Juki placement machines handle automated SMT work, while manual and machine soldering lines support high-reliability requirements. The facility supports volumes ranging from small batches to large-scale production runs, backed by a staff whose collective experience exceeds 500 years.

Customers span Fortune 500 manufacturers such as IBM, Caterpillar, Teledyne Brown Engineering, and Boeing, as well as federal agencies including NASA and the Department of Defense. The company also serves small businesses with specialized needs, providing contract manufacturing across aerospace, defense, industrial equipment, and commercial electronics sectors.

Whitesburg emphasizes a zero-defect mission documented in a corporate quality manual that incorporates MIL‑STD‑45208 inspection requirements, ISO/IEC 17025‑accredited test and calibration, and IPC‑J‑STD‑001/IPC‑A‑610 soldering and acceptance standards. A CFC‑free, EPA‑compliant cleaning process and controlled handling of confidential data round out the quality framework.
